The first release of Bern. Write an app's logic and interface once in Rust, and Bern builds it as a native app for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android, and for the web.

## Install

```sh
cargo binstall bern-cli
```

[cargo-binstall](https://github.com/cargo-bins/cargo-binstall) downloads the `bern` built for your computer from this release. You can also download it below, unpack it and put `bern` on your `PATH`, or compile it with `cargo install bern-cli`.

| Your computer | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac with Apple silicon | `bern-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| Mac with an Intel chip | `bern-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| Windows | `bern-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Windows on Arm | `bern-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Linux | `bern-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| Linux on Arm | `bern-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |

The Linux builds run on distributions with glibc 2.35 or later (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12 and newer) and use the system's libdbus. On a Mac, a `bern` downloaded with a browser is not signed: run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine bern` once before using it.

## Make an app

```sh
bern new my_app
cd my_app
bern run
```

The new app is a window with a counter. `bern run` builds it for this computer and starts it; `bern doctor` lists what this computer still needs for each platform. See the [README](https://github.com/AimesSoft/Bern#quick-start) for more.

---

Bern 的第一个版本。用 Rust 写一次应用的逻辑和界面，Bern 把它构建成 macOS、Windows、Linux、iOS、Android 上的原生应用，以及网页应用。

## 安装

```sh
cargo binstall bern-cli
```

[cargo-binstall](https://github.com/cargo-bins/cargo-binstall) 会从这个版本下载适合你电脑的 `bern`。也可以在下面下载对应的文件，解压后把 `bern` 放进 `PATH`；或者用 `cargo install bern-cli` 自己编译。

| 你的电脑 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| Apple 芯片的 Mac | `bern-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| Intel 芯片的 Mac | `bern-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| Windows | `bern-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| ARM 芯片的 Windows | `bern-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Linux | `bern-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| ARM 芯片的 Linux | `bern-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |

Linux 版需要 glibc 2.35 及以上（Ubuntu 22.04、Debian 12 及更新的发行版），并使用系统自带的 libdbus。在 Mac 上用浏览器下载的 `bern` 没有签名，第一次使用前运行一次 `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine bern`。

## 创建应用

```sh
bern new my_app
cd my_app
bern run
```

新应用是一个带计数器的窗口。`bern run` 为这台电脑构建并启动它；`bern doctor` 列出这台电脑构建各个平台还缺什么。更多内容见 [README](https://github.com/AimesSoft/Bern/blob/master/README.zh-CN.md)。
